objects.description: Enumeration of DHCPv6 message types (including relay and leasequery variants) as defined in RFC 8415 and related RFCs. Used to identify the type of DHCPv6 message on the wire.

External declaration of a DHCP library-wide logger object named dhcp_logger of type isc::log::Logger. The actual Logger class is not defined in this header; only a reference is declared here for use across the DHCP module.

MessageID is referenced via extern declarations but not defined in this header. It is presumably a type from <log/message_types.h> representing an identifier for log messages. No types are defined by this header itself.

objects.definition:
extern const char* DOCSIS3_CLASS_EROUTER;
extern const char* DOCSIS3_CLASS_MODEM;
objects.description: Two external string objects naming DOCSIS3 vendor-class values (erouter and modem). They are declarations only; definitions are provided elsewhere. As built-in pointer types, there is no custom type beyond const char*, but they are included here due to explicit declarations in this header.
Abstract base type providing a common polymorphic root for identifier classes; has a pure virtual destructor to make the class abstract. IdentifierBaseTypePtr is a shared_ptr alias to this base.

Template base class for variable-length identifiers with size constraints, parsing from hex text, formatting to hex text, and equality comparison. It owns the raw byte vector and enforces [min_size, max_size] at construction.

DHCPv6 DUID type derived from IdentifierType<3,130>. Provides constructors enforcing RFC 8415 size limits, access to the underlying bytes, an EMPTY singleton, type decoding via DUIDType enum, and parsing from textual hex. DuidPtr is a shared_ptr alias.
Enumeration of DUID kinds stored in the first two bytes of a DUID as per RFC 8415. Used by DUID::getType(). Note: Declared as a nested typedef within DUID.

Generic DHCPv4 client identifier wrapper derived from IdentifierType<2,255>. Provides constructors enforcing option 61 size limits, access to raw bytes, and parsing from textual hex. ClientIdPtr is a shared_ptr alias.

Non-copyable factory class in namespace isc::dhcp that generates, persists, and returns DHCPv6 DUIDs (per RFC 8415). Supports creating DUID-LLT, DUID-EN, and DUID-LL, optionally inferring or auto-generating missing components. If a storage path is provided, persists the generated DUID and reloads it on demand. Unknowns: exact exception types beyond isc::Unexpected, DuidPtr definition, and storage format are defined outside this header.

Represents a network hardware (MAC) address and associated metadata (hardware type and source) used by ISC DHCP. Provides constants for common hardware address lengths and for enumerating the source from which the MAC was obtained, constructors from raw bytes or vectors, string conversion, parsing from text, and equality/inequality comparisons. Members include the address bytes (hwaddr_), hardware type (htype_, 16-bit to support DHCPv6), and a source code (source_). The specific static source constants are declared here but defined elsewhere. Destruction is trivial; no ownership semantics beyond value members.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<HWAddr> HWAddrPtr;
objects.description: Typedef alias for a shared pointer to isc::dhcp::HWAddr using boost::shared_ptr. Enables shared ownership semantics for HWAddr instances.
Exception type thrown when detection of network interfaces fails within IfaceMgr or related code.
Exception indicating attempts to change the active Packet Filter are not allowed, typically because sockets are open.
Exception thrown when a blocking select() call is interrupted by a signal while receiving.
Exception thrown when opening or configuring a socket fails.
Exception thrown on errors while reading from a socket.
Exception thrown on errors while writing to a socket.
Exception thrown when a requested network interface cannot be found.
Exception thrown when a suitable socket cannot be found for an operation.
Exception thrown when an error is detected on a socket file descriptor.

Non-copyable class representing a single network interface, tracking name, index, MAC, addresses, sockets, flags, and a reusable read buffer. Provides helpers to manage addresses, sockets, and error reporting.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<Iface> IfacePtr;
objects.description: Shared pointer alias to Iface.
Container and lookup/cache helper for interfaces. Provides sequenced, index-based, and name-based access using a boost::multi_index container. Thread-safe cache for fast repeated lookups.

objects.definition:
typedef boost::multi_index_container<
    asiolink::IOAddress,
    boost::multi_index::indexed_by<
        boost::multi_index::hashed_unique<
            boost::multi_index::const_mem_fun<
                asiolink::IOAddress, uint32_t, &asiolink::IOAddress::toUint32
            >
        >
    >
> BoundAddresses;
objects.description: Unordered set (multi_index container) of IPv4 addresses the manager has opened/bound sockets to. Optimized for quick containment checks by 32-bit IPv4 value.

Singleton manager for network interfaces and DHCP socket I/O. Handles interface discovery, socket opening/closing, send/receive for DHCPv4/v6, external socket callbacks, packet queuing threads, and packet filter selection.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<IfaceMgr> IfaceMgrPtr;
objects.description: Shared pointer alias to IfaceMgr (useful for holding the singleton instance).

objects.definition:
typedef
std::function<void(const std::string& errmsg)> IfaceMgrErrorMsgCallback;
objects.description: Function type for error callback invoked by IfaceMgr during socket opening operations to report non-fatal errors.

objects.definition:
typedef ScopedPktOptionsCopy<Pkt4> ScopedPkt4OptionsCopy;
typedef ScopedPktOptionsCopy<Pkt6> ScopedPkt6OptionsCopy;
objects.description: Type aliases for ScopedPktOptionsCopy specialized for Pkt4 and Pkt6. They refer to scoped helpers that keep packet options alive during temporary transformations (e.g., splitting/packing). Exact semantics depend on ScopedPktOptionsCopy, which is only referenced here and defined elsewhere.

objects.definition: typedef std::shared_ptr<ScopedSubOptionsCopy> ScopedOptionsCopyPtr;
objects.description: Shared pointer alias to ScopedSubOptionsCopy objects, which represent scoped holders for copied suboptions. The underlying ScopedSubOptionsCopy type is declared/defined elsewhere.

objects.definition: typedef std::vector<ScopedOptionsCopyPtr> ScopedOptionsCopyContainer;
objects.description: Vector container of ScopedOptionsCopyPtr elements used to keep temporary option copies alive as a group during packing/splitting operations.

RAII wrapper owning a ScopedOptionsCopyContainer. Its destructor resets each stored ScopedOptionsCopyPtr in container order to ensure parents (stored last) outlive children. Use to manage lifetime of temporary option copies safely.

Static utility class providing DHCP option definition catalogs and helpers to pack, split, and unpack DHCPv4/v6 options, handle vendor and runtime option definitions, and register option factories. Holds static state (factory maps, staged runtime defs).

objects.definition: typedef std::map<unsigned short, Option::Factory*> FactoryMap;
objects.description: Map from option code to factory function pointer used to build Option instances. Two static instances exist in LibDHCP: v4factories_ and v6factories_.

Exception type thrown to signal errors operating on an OpaqueDataTuple (e.g., malformed data on pack/unpack). It inherits from isc::Exception. Construction requires file, line, and message parameters.

Represents one opaque-data tuple used in certain DHCP options, consisting of a length field (1 or 2 bytes) and data bytes. Provides methods to append/assign data or strings, pack to wire format with validation, and unpack from wire format. Tracks the length-field size via LengthFieldType and stores data in a byte buffer.
Enumeration nested in OpaqueDataTuple indicating the size/meaning of the tuple’s length field: none/empty, 1 byte, or 2 bytes. Used to control packing/unpacking behavior.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<OpaqueDataTuple> OpaqueDataTuplePtr;
objects.description: Shared-pointer typedef to OpaqueDataTuple using boost::shared_ptr. Facilitates shared ownership and lifetime management of OpaqueDataTuple instances.
OptionBuffer is the DHCP buffer type used to hold contiguous option bytes. Iterators provide traversal of the buffer, and OptionBufferPtr is a shared pointer to a buffer.

Base class representing a DHCP option (for DHCPv4 or DHCPv6). Stores option code, payload bytes, and an optional collection of suboptions. Provides packing/unpacking to wire format, cloning, equality, and helpers for integer accessors/mutators. Universe enum distinguishes V4 vs V6. lenient_parsing_ controls relaxed tuple parsing. Construction is via constructors, factory, or create helpers.

objects.definition:
typedef std::multimap<unsigned int, OptionPtr> OptionCollection;
typedef boost::shared_ptr<OptionCollection> OptionCollectionPtr;
objects.description: A multimap of DHCP options keyed by option code, allowing multiple suboptions of the same type. OptionCollectionPtr is a shared pointer to such a collection.
Exception indicating unpacking should stop processing remaining options but keep the packet. Used when an option failure should not invalidate the entire packet.
Exception indicating the current option should be skipped during unpacking and parsing should continue with the next option. Often used for empty/invalid string options.
Wrapper exception thrown by unpackOptionsX helpers to enrich an underlying error with option type and length information.

DHCPv4 option class representing an option that carries a list of IPv4 addresses (e.g., DNS servers). Provides constructors from empty, a single address, a container of addresses, or raw buffer iterators; supports packing to wire format, cloning, text rendering, and length calculation. Maintains its own AddressContainer of isc::asiolink::IOAddress and offers getters/setters/add for addresses. Details such as validation and packing format are implied by DHCPv4 address-list options but not fully specified here.
Exception type thrown when invalid flags are specified for the DHCPv4 Client FQDN option. Derives from isc::Exception. Constructors forward file, line, and message to the base class.
Exception type thrown when an invalid domain name is provided for the DHCPv4 Client FQDN option. Derives from isc::Exception. Constructors forward file, line, and message to the base class.

objects.definition: class Option4ClientFqdnImpl;
objects.description: Forward declaration of the PIMPL implementation class used by Option4ClientFqdn. No definition present in this header.

Represents DHCPv4 Client FQDN Option (code 81) per RFC 4702. Provides accessors and mutators for flags (S, O, E, N), RCODE1/RCODE2 encapsulated as Rcode, and the domain name (partial or fully qualified). Uses PIMPL via Option4ClientFqdnImpl. Supports construction from values or from wire-format buffers, packing/unpacking, cloning, and textual rendering. Enforces basic validation via exceptions defined in this header. Nested types: Rcode (encapsulates an 8-bit RCODE value) and DomainNameType (PARTIAL, FULL).
direct_api_constructors: isc::dhcp::Option4ClientFqdn::Option4ClientFqdn(const uint8_t, const Rcode&, const std::string&, const DomainNameType)

objects.description: Nested helper class encapsulating an 8-bit RCODE value for RCODE1/RCODE2 fields in the DHCPv4 Client FQDN option. Provides getCode() accessor. Instances typically created via RCODE_SERVER() (255) and RCODE_CLIENT() (0).
Nested enum specifying whether the domain name carried by the option is partial or fully qualified. The underlying type is uint16_t.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<Option4ClientFqdn> Option4ClientFqdnPtr;
objects.description: Typedef alias for a shared pointer to Option4ClientFqdn.

Exception type thrown when an invalid Authentication Domain Name (ADN) is specified for DNR processing. It derives from isc::Exception and carries file, line, and message context. Construction and destruction are standard for exceptions; no special ownership or cleanup required.
Exception type thrown when Service Parameters (SvcParams) for DNR have an invalid format. Inherits from isc::Exception. No special lifecycle requirements.

Represents a single DNR (Discovery of Network-designated Resolvers) instance used in DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 Encrypted DNS options (RFC9463). Holds ADN (resolver FQDN), service priority, optional IP addresses, and SvcParams. Provides pack/unpack to/from wire format and parsing from a convenient text notation. Construct with Option::Universe to select v4/v6-specific field sizes and behavior. ADN-only mode omits address and SvcParams fields. Call setDnrInstanceDataLength() for v4 after populating fields to compute DNR Instance Data Length. Addresses and SvcParams are validated; forbidden SvcParams include ipv4hint/ipv6hint. Destruction is trivial; no external ownership constraints.

DHCPv4 Encrypted DNS option (code 162) per RFC9463. Encapsulates one or more DnrInstance structures. Can be constructed from on-wire data or from a convenient text notation (when convenient_notation is true). Provides standard Option interface for packing, unpacking, textual rendering, and length computation. Ownership: contains a vector of DnrInstance by value.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<Option4Dnr> Option4DnrPtr;
objects.description: Type alias for a shared pointer to Option4Dnr. Use for shared ownership and lifetime management of DHCPv4 DNR option objects.

DHCPv6 option implementation that stores a list of IPv6 addresses (e.g., DNS servers). Provides constructors from a vector of IOAddress, a single IOAddress, or raw buffer iterators for parsing; supports packing to wire format, unpacking, cloning, textual rendering, and setters for one or many addresses. Holds addresses in an internal vector addrs_. Lifetime/ownership is typical for Option-derived classes; details of memory management follow the base Option and any shared_ptr usage outside.

objects.definition: typedef std::vector<isc::asiolink::IOAddress> AddressContainer;
objects.description: Type alias within Option6AddrLst representing the container that stores the IPv6 addresses for the option; it is a std::vector of IOAddress.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<Option6AddrLst> Option6AddrLstPtr;
objects.description: Shared pointer alias to Option6AddrLst, used for owning/managing instances via reference counting.

DHCPv6 Authentication (option code 11) option class. Encapsulates protocol, hash algorithm, replay detection method and value (RDM), and authentication info bytes, with packing/unpacking to wire format and helper packing for hash input. Inherits from Option (defined elsewhere).
direct_api_constructors: isc::dhcp::Option6Auth::Option6Auth(const uint8_t,const uint8_t,const uint8_t,const uint64_t,const std::vector<uint8_t>&)

objects.description: DHCPv6 Identity Association (IA) option class (e.g., IA_NA or IA_PD). Wraps IAID, T1, and T2 timers and supports packing/unpacking to wire format, cloning, textual representation, and length calculation. It is derived from Option (declared elsewhere). Construction supports building from explicit IAID or from a received buffer. T1/T2 are mutable via setters. Specific destruction/ownership semantics follow base Option and any smart-pointer usage; no explicit destructor declared here.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<Option6IA> Option6IAPtr;
objects.description: Typedef alias for a reference-counted smart pointer to Option6IA using boost::shared_ptr. Use this to manage Option6IA lifetimes safely.

DHCPv6 IA Address (IAADDR) option class. Encapsulates an IPv6 address along with preferred and valid lifetimes, provides packing/unpacking to/from wire format, cloning, text representation, and length calculation. Inherits from Option. Used to represent an IA_NA/IA_TA bound address within DHCPv6 messages.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<Option6IAAddr> Option6IAAddrPtr;
objects.description: Smart pointer typedef for Option6IAAddr using boost::shared_ptr. Manages lifetime of Option6IAAddr instances via shared ownership.

DHCPv6 IAPREFIX option class representing an IA Prefix (RFC 3633/8415) with base IPv6 address and prefix length, along with preferred and valid lifetimes. It extends Option6IAAddr to reuse address/lifetime handling but enforces prefix semantics: on unpack, non-significant bits beyond prefix length are zeroed via mask(). Use setPrefix/getLength along with inherited getAddress() to manage the prefix. Construction supports building from explicit fields or parsing from on-the-wire buffers. Packing throws if address is not IPv6. Length constant indicates fixed body size (25 bytes) excluding option header.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<Option6IAPrefix> Option6IAPrefixPtr;
objects.description: Smart pointer typedef for Option6IAPrefix using boost::shared_ptr. Use to manage lifetime of Option6IAPrefix instances via shared ownership.

DHCPv6 option class for RFC 6603 Prefix Exclude (option code 67). It derives from Option and encapsulates the excluded prefix length and the computed IPv6 subnet ID field per RFC 6603 section 4.2. Provides constructors from parameters or from a wire buffer, pack/unpack, size, text rendering, and helpers to obtain the excluded prefix, its length, and the raw subnet ID. Destruction/ownership follows C++ semantics; no custom destructor is defined here. Details such as validation rules are documented in comments (e.g., excluded prefix length must be greater than delegated prefix length; common prefix bits must match).
direct_api_constructors: Option6PDExclude(const isc::asiolink::IOAddress& delegated_prefix, const uint8_t delegated_prefix_length, const isc::asiolink::IOAddress& excluded_prefix, const uint8_t excluded_prefix_length)

objects.description: Represents the DHCPv6 Status Code option (code 13, RFC 8415). Stores a 16-bit status code and an associated textual message. Provides construction from explicit values or by parsing on-wire option data; supports cloning, packing to an output buffer, unpacking from a buffer, computing length, and textual rendering.
direct_api_constructors: Option6StatusCode(const uint16_t status_code, const std::string& status_message)

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<Option6StatusCode> Option6StatusCodePtr;
objects.description: Smart-pointer typedef referring to isc::dhcp::Option6StatusCode instances using boost::shared_ptr.

Represents the DHCPv4 SLP Service Scope option (code 79, RFC 2610). Encapsulates a mandatory flag and a textual list of scopes. Supports construction from explicit values or by parsing on-wire data; provides cloning, packing, unpacking, length computation, and textual rendering.
direct_api_constructors: Option4SlpServiceScope(const bool mandatory_flag, const std::string& scope_list)

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<Option4SlpServiceScope> Option4SlpServiceScopePtr;
objects.description: Smart-pointer typedef referring to isc::dhcp::Option4SlpServiceScope instances using boost::shared_ptr.

objects.definition: typedef std::tuple<asiolink::IOAddress, uint8_t, asiolink::IOAddress> StaticRouteTuple;
objects.description: Tuple representing a classless static route entry: destination subnet (IOAddress), subnet mask width in bits (uint8_t), and the IPv4 router (next-hop) address (IOAddress). Used internally by OptionClasslessStaticRoute to store routes.

DHCPv4 option (code 121) handler for Classless Static Route (RFC 3442). Provides construction from wire data or a human-friendly string, (un)packing to/from wire format, textual representation, and length computation. Internally stores a vector of StaticRouteTuple entries and maintains encoded data length. Ownership and lifetime follow typical Option-derived semantics; cloning returns OptionPtr.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<OptionClasslessStaticRoute> OptionClasslessStaticRoutePtr;
objects.description: Shared pointer alias to OptionClasslessStaticRoute for managed ownership and shared use across the API.

Concrete DHCP option class with a structured layout (array/record of typed fields). Stores each field as an OptionBuffer and offers typed read/write helpers (integers, addresses, strings, tuples, prefixes, PSID). Constructed from an OptionDefinition and Universe and optionally initial data or iterators. Used when no more specialized Option subclass fits. Lifetime and memory owned internally; buffers_ mirrors defined fields order.

OptionCustom::OptionCustom(const OptionDefinition& def, Universe u, OptionBufferConstIter first, OptionBufferConstIter last)

objects.description: Shared-pointer typedef to OptionCustom instances for ownership and sharing semantics.
Exception type thrown when an unsupported or invalid option data type is used as a template parameter or operation target within DHCP option utilities.
Exception indicating a failure to cast/parse raw option data into the requested data type (e.g., truncated buffers, invalid boolean, malformed FQDN).

struct OptionDefParams {
    const char*             name;           // option name
    uint16_t                code;           // option code
    const char*             space;          // option space
    OptionDataType          type;           // data type

                                            // particular option.
};
objects.description: Plain-OLD-data parameter bundle describing an option definition (name, code, space, primary type, array flag, record field types, and encapsulated space).
Helper POD that encapsulates an OptionDefParams pointer plus the structure size and the target option space name; used for bulk/encapsulated registrations.

Primary trait template describing support characteristics for types used in option encoding/decoding. Specializations in this header provide metadata (valid, size, integer flag, mapped OptionDataType).
Trait specialization for boolean option values (encoded as one byte 0/1).
Trait specialization marking int8_t as a supported 1-byte signed integer data type.
Trait specialization for 2-byte signed integer option data.
Trait specialization for 4-byte signed integer option data.
Trait specialization for 1-byte unsigned integer option data.
Trait specialization for 2-byte unsigned integer option data.
Trait specialization for 4-byte unsigned integer option data.
Trait specialization for variable-length string option data.
Small value type wrapping a PSID length in bits (0..16). Validates upper bound and offers typed accessors for logging/serialization.
Wrapper for a 16-bit PSID value. No range checking beyond storage width; intended to be paired with PSIDLen to constrain significant bits.

objects.definition: typedef std::pair<PSIDLen, PSID> PSIDTuple;
objects.description: Alias representing a tuple of PSID length and PSID value used by option encoders/decoders.
Wrapper for an IP prefix length (0..128). Header comment claims range check intention; current constructor does not enforce it here.

objects.definition: typedef std::pair<PrefixLen, asiolink::IOAddress> PrefixTuple;
objects.description: Alias for a tuple of prefix length and IOAddress prefix value used for encoding/decoding IPv6 prefix-type option data.

Singleton-style utility class exposing static helpers to map data type names/enums and to encode/decode supported DHCP option payload types (addresses, integers, strings, tuples, FQDNs, prefixes, PSIDs, booleans). Contains templates relying on OptionDataTypeTraits. Construction is internal via instance().
Exception type thrown when an invalid option value is specified for a given DHCP option definition. Inherits from isc::Exception. Construction passes file, line, and message to base.
Exception type thrown when an option definition itself is invalid/malformed. Inherits from isc::Exception.
Exception type thrown when attempting to define a duplicate option definition. Inherits from isc::Exception.

Base class that describes the format and behavior of a DHCP option, including name, code, option space, data type(s), array/record semantics, and optional encapsulated sub-option space. Provides factory methods to construct Option instances from buffers or string values, validation, and utilities for special formats. Inherits from data::StampedElement for timestamps/IDs and carries a data::UserContext.

objects.definition:
typedef boost::multi_index_container<
    OptionDefinitionPtr,
    boost::multi_index::indexed_by<
        boost::multi_index::sequenced<>,
        boost::multi_index::hashed_non_unique<
            boost::multi_index::const_mem_fun<
                OptionDefinition,
                uint16_t,
                &OptionDefinition::getCode
            >
        >,
        boost::multi_index::hashed_non_unique<
            boost::multi_index::const_mem_fun<
                OptionDefinition,
                std::string,
                &OptionDefinition::getName
            >
        >,
        boost::multi_index::ordered_non_unique<
            boost::multi_index::const_mem_fun<
                data::BaseStampedElement,
                boost::posix_time::ptime,
                &data::StampedElement::getModificationTime
            >
        >,
        boost::multi_index::hashed_non_unique<
            boost::multi_index::tag<OptionIdIndexTag>,
            boost::multi_index::const_mem_fun<data::BaseStampedElement, uint64_t,
                                              &data::BaseStampedElement::getId>
        >
    >
> OptionDefContainer;

objects.definition: typedef std::map<std::string, OptionDefContainerPtr> OptionDefContainers;
objects.description: Mapping from option space name to its OptionDefContainer. Used to organize option definitions per space.

objects.definition: typedef std::map<uint32_t, OptionDefContainerPtr> VendorOptionDefContainers;
objects.description: Mapping from vendor identifier (uint32_t) to an OptionDefContainer for vendor-specific option definitions.

Alias for a parameterization of OptionSpaceContainer that manages OptionDefContainer instances keyed by std::string space names. Provides shared functionality for option definition space containers. Full definition of OptionSpaceContainer is not in this header.

Concrete space container for option definitions. Inherits BaseOptionDefSpaceContainer and exposes an addItem that derives the key from the OptionDefinition’s own option space name to avoid mismatches.

Template class representing a DHCP option whose payload is a single integer of type T (supported sizes 1, 2, or 4 bytes; signed or unsigned). Provides packing/unpacking to wire format, cloning, textual rendering, and length calculation; also maintains suboptions via base Option. Aliases defined in this header include OptionUint8 and its shared_ptr typedef.

typedef boost::shared_ptr<OptionUint16> OptionUint16Ptr;
objects.description: Alias specialization of OptionInt for 16-bit unsigned integer DHCP options. Behaves exactly like OptionInt<uint16_t>.

typedef boost::shared_ptr<OptionUint32> OptionUint32Ptr;
objects.description: Alias specialization of OptionInt for 32-bit unsigned integer DHCP options. Behaves exactly like OptionInt<uint32_t>.

objects.description: Alias for OptionIntArray instantiated with uint32_t element type.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<OptionUint32Array> OptionUint32ArrayPtr;
objects.description: Shared pointer typedef to OptionIntArray<uint32_t>.

DHCP option subclass that encapsulates a collection of opaque data tuples (e.g., for DHCPv6 Bootfile-Param option 60 per RFC 5970). It stores a vector of OpaqueDataTuple and provides packing/unpacking to/from wire format, tuple management (add/replace/get), search, and textual representation. The tuple length field size can be specified or inferred from the option universe. Construction requires an option universe (v4 or v6) and option code; a buffer-based constructor parses existing on-wire data. Destruction, copying, and memory management follow typical C++ object semantics of Option-derived types. Details of OpaqueDataTuple and Option are defined elsewhere.

objects.definition: typedef std::vector<OpaqueDataTuple> TuplesCollection;
objects.description: Type alias defined inside OptionOpaqueDataTuples for the container holding the option's opaque data tuples. It is a std::vector of OpaqueDataTuple.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<OptionOpaqueDataTuples> OptionOpaqueDataTuplesPtr;
objects.description: Shared pointer typedef to OptionOpaqueDataTuples, using boost::shared_ptr.

Exception type thrown when an invalid DHCP option space is specified. Inherits from isc::Exception and forwards file, line, and message to the base class. Used to signal invalid or empty option-space names during validation or construction.

Represents a DHCP option space (primarily DHCPv4, but also used as a base for some DHCPv6 cases). Stores the space name and whether it is vendor-specific. Provides validation for names and toggles for vendor-specific status.

DHCPv6 option space with optional IANA enterprise number. Extends OptionSpace by tracking the enterprise number for Vendor Specific Information Options (VSIO). Can represent both vendor-specific and non-vendor DHCPv6 spaces.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<OptionSpace> OptionSpacePtr;
objects.description: Smart-pointer typedef for OptionSpace using boost::shared_ptr. Use this to manage OptionSpace lifetimes via reference counting.

objects.definition: typedef std::map<std::string, OptionSpacePtr> OptionSpaceCollection;
objects.description: Associative container mapping option space names to OptionSpace smart pointers. Facilitates lookup and management of multiple option spaces.

Empty tag type used with Boost.MultiIndex (or similar) to name/address an index that organizes items by database identifier (id). It enables code like container->get<OptionIdIndexTag>() to access the id index.

Concrete DHCP option type that carries a single non-empty string value with trailing NULs trimmed per RFC 2132 §2. Supports construction from an explicit string or from raw option payload iterators, packing/unpacking to on-wire format, cloning, and textual rendering. Inherits from Option (defined elsewhere). Minimal payload size is 1 byte after trimming; methods may throw isc::OutOfRange on empty string or truncated buffers.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<OptionString> OptionStringPtr;
objects.description: Typedef alias for a reference-counted smart pointer to OptionString using boost::shared_ptr.

DHCP vendor-specific information option (per RFC 3925) supporting both DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 universes. Inherits from isc::dhcp::Option and encapsulates a 32-bit enterprise (vendor) identifier with pack/unpack, length, cloning, and text rendering. The detailed wire format handling differs between v4 and v6 as implemented in pack/unpack. Construction can be from explicit universe and vendor-id or by parsing buffers (which may throw on errors).

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<OptionVendor> OptionVendorPtr;
objects.description: Smart pointer typedef aliasing boost::shared_ptr to manage isc::dhcp::OptionVendor instances with shared ownership semantics.

Concrete DHCP option class that encapsulates DHCPv6 Vendor Class (option 16) and DHCPv4 V-I Vendor Class (option 124). It stores a vendor enterprise ID and a collection of opaque data tuples. Construction can be from parameters (universe, vendor_id) or by unpacking on-wire data; pack/unpack handle v4/v6 wire differences. Provides tuple management (add/set/get), query methods, and textual/length rendering. Destruction/ownership follow base Option semantics; no custom deleter specified. Details of OpaqueDataTuple and Option are external to this header.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<OptionVendorClass> OptionVendorClassPtr;
objects.description: Smart pointer alias for OptionVendorClass instances using boost::shared_ptr. Enables shared ownership semantics for options in APIs using Boost smart pointers.

Custom exception indicating an invalid or missing parameter was supplied to a packet queue. Inherits from isc::Exception and forwards file, line, and message to the base. Thrown when queue parameters are malformed or absent.
Enum class identifying which end of a queue is referenced: FRONT (usually the read/dequeue end) or BACK (usually the write/enqueue end).

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<PacketQueue<Pkt4Ptr>> PacketQueue4Ptr;
objects.description: Typedef alias for a shared pointer to a DHCPv4 packet queue interface (PacketQueue<Pkt4Ptr>). Used by application-level components (e.g., IfaceMgr) and factories returning DHCPv4 queues.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<PacketQueue<Pkt6Ptr>> PacketQueue6Ptr;
objects.description: Typedef alias for a shared pointer to a DHCPv6 packet queue interface (PacketQueue<Pkt6Ptr>). Used by application-level components (e.g., IfaceMgr) and factories returning DHCPv6 queues.

Exception type thrown when a packet queue manager does not recognize the requested packet queue type. It derives from isc::Exception and is constructed with file, line, and message. Used to signal unsupported "queue-type" values during queue creation.

Concrete manager class for DHCPv4 packet queues. Inherits from PacketQueueMgr templated with PacketQueue4Ptr. It exposes a logical name for the default queue type (DEFAULT_QUEUE_TYPE4), constructs by registering a default factory for DHCPv4 queues, and provides a virtual destructor. Full behavior of management operations is defined in the base class and accompanying implementation, not shown here.

objects.definition:

typedef boost::shared_ptr<PacketQueueMgr4> PacketQueueMgr4Ptr;
objects.description: Type alias defining a Boost shared_ptr to PacketQueueMgr4. Use this to manage lifetime of PacketQueueMgr4 instances via shared ownership semantics. Note: actual pointer type of the alias is boost::shared_ptr<isc::dhcp::PacketQueueMgr4>; here we present its pointer form as required.

DHCPv6-specific packet queue manager class. It derives from PacketQueueMgr<PacketQueue6Ptr> to manage known queue implementations and selection of the active queue instance. It is non-copyable (boost::noncopyable). Exposes a static string DEFAULT_QUEUE_TYPE6 naming the default queue type. Constructor is expected to register the default DHCPv6 queue factory. Destructor is trivial.

typedef boost::shared_ptr<PacketQueueMgr6> PacketQueueMgr6Ptr;
objects.description: Alias typedef for a boost::shared_ptr to PacketQueueMgr6. Use to manage shared ownership of PacketQueueMgr6 instances.
Small value class describing a timestamped packet lifecycle event. Provides static well-known labels and helpers to obtain current time and sentinel times. Used by Pkt to track timing.

Abstract base class for DHCP message representations shared by Pkt4 and Pkt6. Manages addresses, ports, interface info, options container, timestamping and event tracking, MAC extraction helpers, and pack/unpack virtuals. Not directly constructible; derived classes must implement wire-format specifics and MAC-source helpers.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<isc::dhcp::Pkt> PktPtr;
objects.description: Type alias for a shared pointer to isc::dhcp::Pkt.
RAII helper that snapshots an Option's suboptions on construction and restores them on destruction. Useful around hook processing or transformations that temporarily modify suboptions.

DHCPv4 packet class. Represents and manipulates DHCPv4 messages: fields, options, packing/unpacking, labeling, and basic validations. It derives from Pkt (defined elsewhere). It encapsulates BOOTP/DHCPv4 header fields, option handling, and helpers. Construction is via provided constructors for outgoing and incoming packets. Destruction/ownership follows standard C++ semantics; options and buffers are managed internally. Many MAC-extraction hooks are no-ops in v4.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<Pkt4> Pkt4Ptr;
objects.description: Smart pointer alias to Pkt4 using boost::shared_ptr. Use to manage Pkt4 lifetime with shared ownership semantics.

Class representing a DHCPv4-over-DHCPv6 packet (RFC 7341). It derives from Pkt4 so it can be handled by DHCPv4 server code while carrying an encapsulating DHCPv6 message (Pkt6Ptr) and coordinating pack()/option-copy behaviors across both layers. Provides constructors for received packets (raw v4 option buffer + v6 message) and for replies (Pkt4Ptr + Pkt6Ptr), access to the encapsulating Pkt6, and overrides for packing and copy-retrieved-options. Details of memory ownership and wire-format assembly follow Pkt4/Pkt6 semantics; pkt6_ is held as a shared pointer.
direct_api_constructors: isc::dhcp::Pkt4o6::Pkt4o6(const OptionBuffer& pkt4, const Pkt6Ptr& pkt6)
isc::dhcp::Pkt4o6::Pkt4o6(const Pkt4Ptr& pkt4, const Pkt6Ptr& pkt6)

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<Pkt4o6> Pkt4o6Ptr;
objects.description: Typedef alias for a shared pointer to isc::dhcp::Pkt4o6 using boost::shared_ptr. Use this to manage Pkt4o6 lifetimes via shared ownership semantics.

DHCPv6 packet class representing both inbound and outbound DHCPv6 messages. Supports parsing/packing, option handling (including relay-encapsulated options), relay chain management, and message identification. Inherits common packet functionality from isc::dhcp::Pkt (declared elsewhere). Includes nested enums for transport protocol and relay option search order and a RelayInfo struct describing a single relay encapsulation layer.

Describes a single relay encapsulation layer for a DHCPv6 message: relay message type, hop count, link and peer addresses, computed relay message length, and options present at that relay level. Used within Pkt6 to represent nested relay-forw/relay-repl headers and options.
Enumeration of transport protocols supported by Pkt6 for DHCPv6: UDP (typical) or TCP (used e.g. for bulk leasequery/failover).
Enumeration defining how to search through multiple relay encapsulation layers for options: from client side inward, from server side outward, or retrieve only the first or last relay scope.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<Pkt6> Pkt6Ptr;
objects.description: Smart-pointer typedef for Pkt6 using boost::shared_ptr. Use to manage Pkt6 lifetimes across APIs without manual delete. Pointer semantics and shared ownership apply.

Exception type thrown when an invalid packet filter object is specified. It derives from isc::Exception and offers a constructor passing file, line, and message to the base. No additional behavior is defined.

objects.definition: struct SocketInfo;
objects.description: Forward declaration of a structure describing a primary and optional fallback socket used for DHCPv4 packet I/O. The full definition is not present in this header; details are unknown here.

objects.definition: class Iface;
objects.description: Forward declaration of an interface-representing class (network interface descriptor). The full definition is not present in this header; details are unknown here.

Abstract base class providing low-level DHCPv4 packet I/O and filtering. Derived classes implement specific socket families/types and filtering (e.g., LPF/BPF), including opening sockets, receiving/sending packets, and optional fallback socket handling. It requires implementations for direct response capability, timestamp support, socket opening, receive, and send. Provides a protected helper to open a fallback UDP socket bound to an address/port, which may throw SocketConfigError.

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<PktFilter> PktFilterPtr;
objects.description: Smart-pointer typedef (boost::shared_ptr) managing PktFilter instances.

objects.definition: struct SocketInfo;
objects.description: Forward declaration for a structure that describes a socket used by the DHCPv6 packet filter. The full definition is not present in this header, so its fields and ownership semantics are unknown here.

objects.definition: class Iface;
objects.description: Forward declaration for a class representing a network interface abstraction used by DHCP logic. Its definition is not present in this header; methods and lifecycle are unknown here.

Abstract base class defining the low-level IPv6 socket operations for DHCPv6 (open, receive, send) along with a helper to join an IPv6 multicast group. Intended to be subclassed with platform-specific implementations and used by IfaceMgr. Lifecycle: polymorphic with virtual destructor; instances are typically managed via shared pointers (see PktFilter6Ptr).

objects.definition: typedef boost::shared_ptr<PktFilter6> PktFilter6Ptr;
objects.description: Shared-pointer alias for PktFilter6 instances, enabling shared ownership semantics of packet filter implementations.

Concrete packet filter implementation using BSD Berkeley Packet Filter (BPF) devices. Provides open/receive/send for DHCPv4 traffic via BPF, including support for direct responses to clients without configured IP addresses and retrieval of socket receive timestamps. Also includes a helper to write a 4-byte address-family pseudo header for loopback transmissions. Construction is via default constructor (implicitly declared); destruction is via the base class virtual destructor (defined elsewhere). No additional data members are declared here.

Concrete packet filter implementation for DHCPv4 using AF_INET/UDP sockets (SOCK_DGRAM). It inherits from PktFilter and provides socket open/receive/send tailored to IPv4 datagram sockets. Direct hardware-address-based responses are not supported. The private static constant CONTROL_BUF_LEN defines the size for ancillary control data buffer used when receiving timestamps or other control messages. Details like exact semantics and lifecycle are governed by PktFilter; this header declares the interface, not the implementations.

Concrete DHCPv6 packet filter that uses IPv6/UDP datagram sockets. It derives from PktFilter6 (declared elsewhere) and provides methods to open sockets, receive, and send DHCPv6 packets. It also exposes whether socket receive timestamping is supported. The only data member declared here is a private static constant indicating ancillary control buffer length; its value is defined elsewhere.

Concrete packet filter implementation for DHCPv4 using Linux Packet Filtering (LPF) and raw sockets. It derives from PktFilter and provides methods to open sockets, receive, and send packets. Intended for use by IfaceMgr to communicate with hosts that may not yet have IPv4 addresses. Only the class declaration is present here; method implementations are defined elsewhere.

Exception type thrown when parsing of link, Internet, or transport layer headers fails. It derives from Exception (defined elsewhere) and forwards file/line/message to the base class. No additional members. Used by decodeEthernetHeader and decodeIpUdpHeader to signal truncated or invalid headers.

POD-like struct carrying socket binding information for DHCP I/O: bound address (IOAddress), port, address family derived from the address, the primary socket file descriptor, and an optional fallback socket descriptor used when a raw socket is primary. Negative fallbackfd_ indicates no fallback socket. Constructed directly via its constructor. Lifetime and ownership are external; this struct does not manage closing descriptors.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::getIface

requirements: pkt must carry either a valid interface index or name to resolve (explicit note).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::getIfaces
functions.description: Returns the collection of detected interfaces.
requirements: The returned reference is valid only while the IfaceMgr singleton exists (explicit note).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::clearIfaces
functions.description: Removes all detected interfaces (useful for tests to inject custom interfaces).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::setDetectCallback
functions.description: Installs a callback invoked before system-dependent interface detection calls.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::checkDetectIfaces
functions.description: Invokes the detect callback to determine whether to proceed with system-specific detection; returns its decision.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::detectIfaces
functions.description: Detects system interfaces and their addresses. Honors the detect callback: if it returns false, returns immediately.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::clearUnicasts
functions.description: Clears unicast listen addresses on all interfaces.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::clearBoundAddresses
functions.description: Clears the cached set of IPv4 addresses to which sockets are currently bound.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::collectBoundAddresses
functions.description: Rebuilds the set of IPv4 addresses that currently have open sockets bound for quick lookup.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::getSocket
functions.description: Selects and returns the socket descriptor suitable for sending the given IPv6 packet via its outbound interface.
requirements: pkt must have its outbound interface specified; otherwise IfaceNotFound may be thrown (explicit).
A suitable socket must exist on the interface; otherwise SocketNotFound is thrown (explicit).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::getSocket
functions.description: Selects and returns the IPv4 socket for sending the given packet, preferring one bound to the packet's local address; falls back to the first IPv4 socket on that interface.
requirements: pkt must provide a local address and a valid interface pointer (explicit).
Throws SocketNotFound if no suitable socket exists (explicit).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::printIfaces
functions.description: Prints diagnostic information about detected interfaces to the provided output stream.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::send
functions.description: Sends the given DHCPv6 packet using socket parameters embedded in the packet (destination, ports, interface).
requirements: pkt must reference a valid interface; otherwise isc::BadValue may be thrown (explicit).
On sendmsg() failure, isc::dhcp::SocketWriteError is thrown (explicit).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::send
functions.description: Sends the given DHCPv4 packet using socket parameters embedded in the packet (destination, ports, interface).
requirements: pkt must reference a valid interface; otherwise isc::BadValue may be thrown (explicit).
On sendmsg() failure, isc::dhcp::SocketWriteError is thrown (explicit).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::receive6
functions.description: Receives a single DHCPv6 packet, using direct or queued mode depending on packet queue configuration. May also process external sockets.
requirements: timeout_usec must be <= 1,000,000 if passed through to direct/indirect receivers (inferred from underlying methods' comments).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::receive4
functions.description: Receives a single DHCPv4 packet, using direct or queued mode depending on packet queue configuration. May also process external sockets.
requirements: timeout_usec must be <= 1,000,000 if passed through to direct/indirect receivers (explicit in underlying methods).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::openSocket
functions.signature: int isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::openSocket(const std::string& ifname, const isc::asiolink::IOAddress& addr, const uint16_t port, const bool receive_bcast = false, const bool send_bcast = false)
functions.description: Opens a UDP socket (v4 or v6 based on addr family) bound to the given interface, address, and port. For IPv4, can configure broadcast send/receive; for IPv6 can join multicast when requested.
requirements: ifname must name an existing interface with the given address.
May throw on socket create/bind/multicast join failures (explicit).
When IPv4 and send_bcast is true, underlying OS must support broadcast on the interface; otherwise behavior may fail (implicit from description).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::openSocketFromIface
functions.signature: int isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::openSocketFromIface(const std::string& ifname, const uint16_t port, const uint8_t family)
functions.description: Opens a UDP socket bound to the specified interface and port, selecting an address of the given family found on that interface. Does not join multicast.
requirements: family must be AF_INET or AF_INET6 (inferred).
Throws isc::Unexpected on create/bind failure (explicit).
Throws isc::BadValue if the interface has no address of the requested family (explicit).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::openSocketFromAddress
functions.signature: int isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::openSocketFromAddress(const isc::asiolink::IOAddress& addr, const uint16_t port)
functions.description: Opens a UDP socket bound to the given local address and port, inferring the interface. Does not join multicast.
requirements: addr must be configured on some interface; otherwise isc::BadValue is thrown (explicit).
Throws isc::Unexpected on create/bind failure (explicit).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::openSocketFromRemoteAddress
functions.signature: int isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::openSocketFromRemoteAddress(const isc::asiolink::IOAddress& remote_addr, const uint16_t port)
functions.description: Opens a UDP socket for communicating with a remote endpoint by first identifying an appropriate local address, then binding using openSocket. Does not join multicast.
requirements: remote_addr must be reachable such that a local address can be identified; otherwise isc::Unexpected is thrown (explicit).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::openSockets6
functions.signature: bool isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::openSockets6(const uint16_t port = DHCP6_SERVER_PORT, isc::dhcp::IfaceMgrErrorMsgCallback error_handler = 0, const bool skip_opened = false)
functions.description: Opens IPv6 sockets across detected interfaces that are active (inactive6_ == false). Reports errors via callback if provided, otherwise throws. Starts the DHCPv6 receiver thread if queues are enabled.
requirements: Caller should call IfaceMgr::closeSockets() beforehand to avoid binding conflicts (explicit warning).
Interfaces that are down, not running, or loopback (when disallowed) will cause errors to be reported (explicit).
If error_handler is null, failures throw exceptions (explicit).
skip_opened true will skip addresses already having the open port (explicit).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::openSockets4
functions.signature: bool isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::openSockets4(const uint16_t port = DHCP4_SERVER_PORT, const bool use_bcast = true, isc::dhcp::IfaceMgrErrorMsgCallback error_handler = 0, const bool skip_opened = false)
functions.description: Opens IPv4 sockets across detected interfaces that are active (inactive4_ == false) using the configured PktFilter. Can enable broadcast capability. Reports errors via callback if provided, otherwise throws. Starts the DHCPv4 receiver thread if queues are enabled.
requirements: Caller should call IfaceMgr::closeSockets() beforehand to avoid binding conflicts (explicit warning).
Interfaces that are down, not running, or loopback (when disallowed) will cause errors to be reported (explicit).
Multiple broadcast-capable interfaces may require SO_BINDTODEVICE; if unsupported, only first can be broadcast-capable and others report errors (explicit).
If error_handler is null, failures throw exceptions (explicit).
skip_opened true will skip addresses already having the open port (explicit).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::closeSockets
functions.description: Stops the DHCP receiver thread (if running) and closes all open interface sockets.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::countIfaces
functions.description: Returns the number of detected interfaces.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::addExternalSocket
functions.description: Registers an external socket and a callback to be invoked when it becomes ready (read/hup/error).
requirements: All operations on external sockets should be performed from the main thread (explicit note).
Callback must not block (explicit note).
External sockets are scanned on subsequent receive calls; adding/removing is effective after next receive (explicit note).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::isExternalSocket
functions.description: Returns true if the given fd is registered as an external socket.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::isExternalSocketUnusable
functions.description: Returns true if the given external socket is registered and marked unusable.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::deleteExternalSocket
functions.description: Unregisters an external socket. Should be called before the caller closes that fd.
requirements: Must be called before closing the socket externally (explicit note).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::deleteAllExternalSockets
functions.description: Unregisters all external sockets. Intended for unit tests.
requirements: Intended for unit tests (explicit note).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::setPacketFilter
functions.description: Sets the DHCPv4 packet filter implementation used for opening/using IPv4 sockets.
requirements: packet_filter must not be null; otherwise InvalidPacketFilter is thrown (explicit).
There must be no open IPv4 sockets; otherwise PacketFilterChangeDenied is thrown (explicit).
Caller should close IPv4 sockets first via closeSockets(AF_INET) (explicit guidance).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::setPacketFilter
functions.description: Sets the DHCPv6 packet filter implementation used for opening/using IPv6 sockets.
requirements: packet_filter must not be null; otherwise isc::dhcp::InvalidPacketFilter is thrown (explicit).
There must be no open IPv6 sockets; otherwise isc::dhcp::PacketFilterChangeDenied is thrown (explicit).
Caller should close IPv6 sockets first via closeSockets(AF_INET6) (explicit guidance).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::setMatchingPacketFilter
functions.description: Selects and installs an appropriate DHCPv4 packet filter for the current OS. If direct_response_desired is true, prefers one that supports direct replies to address-less clients, if available.
requirements: If no direct-response-capable implementation exists for the OS, falls back to PktFilterInet (explicit).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::addInterface
functions.description: Adds an interface to the manager’s collection (used by tests as well).
requirements: Throws Unexpected if an interface with the same name or index already exists (explicit).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::hasOpenSocket
functions.description: Returns true if at least one socket of the specified address family is open.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::hasOpenSocket
functions.description: Returns true if a socket is open and bound to the specified address. For some OSes, IPv6 multicast bindings may appear as "::" and still match.
requirements: If only port is bound and address is unspecified, the method checks whether the address is configured on an interface (explicit note).
On BSD/Solaris, matching may be against "::" for sockets joined to ff02::1:2 (explicit note).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::getPacketQueueMgr4
functions.description: Returns the DHCPv4 packet queue manager instance.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::getPacketQueue4
functions.description: Returns the DHCPv4 receiver packet queue from the queue manager.
requirements: Assumes packet_queue_mgr4_ is initialized when queueing is enabled (inferred).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::getPacketQueueMgr6
functions.description: Returns the DHCPv6 packet queue manager instance.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::getPacketQueue6
functions.description: Returns the DHCPv6 receiver packet queue from the queue manager.
requirements: Assumes packet_queue_mgr6_ is initialized when queueing is enabled (inferred).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::startDHCPReceiver
functions.description: Starts the DHCP packet receiver thread for the specified family (AF_INET or AF_INET6) if the corresponding packet queue exists.
requirements: Throws Unexpected if the receiver thread already exists (explicit).
family must be AF_INET or AF_INET6 (inferred).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::stopDHCPReceiver
functions.description: Stops and deletes the DHCP receiver thread if running and flushes the packet queue.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::isDHCPReceiverRunning
functions.description: Returns true if a receiver exists and its thread is currently running.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::IfaceMgr::configureDHCPPacketQueue
functions.description: Configures DHCP packet queueing (create/destroy appropriate queue) based on the given configuration. Throws if the receiver thread is running.
requirements: Throws InvalidOperation if the receiver thread is currently running (explicit).
family must be AF_INET or AF_INET6 (inferred).
queue_control should contain "dhcp-queue-control" content (explicit).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::getOptionDefs
functions.signature: static const OptionDefContainerPtr isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::getOptionDefs(const std::string& space)
functions.description: Returns the collection of option definitions registered for the given option space name. Use to look up how options in that space should be parsed/packed.
requirements: space must be a valid, known option space name; otherwise the function may return a null/empty pointer
Caller must check the returned pointer for null before dereferencing

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::getOptionDef
functions.signature: static OptionDefinitionPtr isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::getOptionDef(const std::string& space, const uint16_t code)
functions.description: Returns the first option definition in the given option space matching the option code. Useful to parse or construct a specific option by code.
requirements: space must name a known option space; otherwise null may be returned
code is an option code for that space; if not present, result is null
Caller must check the returned pointer for null before use

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::getVendorOptionDef
functions.signature: static OptionDefinitionPtr isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::getVendorOptionDef(const Option::Universe u, const uint32_t vendor_id, const uint16_t code)
functions.description: Returns the vendor-specific option definition for a given universe (v4 or v6), enterprise/vendor ID, and option code.
requirements: u must be Option::V4 or Option::V6
vendor_id must be a valid enterprise number for which definitions are known; otherwise returns null
code must be valid for the vendor space; otherwise returns null
Caller must check for null before use

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::getRuntimeOptionDef
functions.signature: static OptionDefinitionPtr isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::getRuntimeOptionDef(const std::string& space, const uint16_t code)
functions.description: Returns a non-standard (runtime) option definition by option space and code. Runtime definitions are typically configured at runtime (e.g., via server config).
requirements: space must refer to a space containing runtime definitions
If the definition is not present, returns null; caller must check for null

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::getRuntimeOptionDefs
functions.description: Returns the container of runtime (non-standard) option definitions for the specified option space.
requirements: space must refer to a space containing runtime definitions; otherwise null may be returned
Caller must check the returned pointer for null before dereferencing

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::getLastResortOptionDef
functions.signature: static OptionDefinitionPtr isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::getLastResortOptionDef(const std::string& space, const uint16_t code)
functions.description: Returns a last-resort option definition by space and code. Used when no standard/runtime definition applies.
requirements: space must refer to a space with last-resort definitions; otherwise null may be returned
If the definition is not present, returns null; caller must check for null

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::getLastResortOptionDefs
functions.description: Returns the container of last-resort option definitions for the specified option space.
requirements: space must refer to a space with last-resort definitions; otherwise null may be returned
Caller must check the returned pointer for null before dereferencing

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::shouldDeferOptionUnpack
functions.signature: static bool isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::shouldDeferOptionUnpack(const std::string& space, const uint16_t code)
functions.description: Indicates whether unpacking of an option should be deferred. For DHCPv4, certain option codes (43 and 224–254) are deferred until after classification.
requirements: space and code should match the packet’s option space and actual option code
Caller must honor the returned boolean to avoid premature parsing of deferred options

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::optionFactory
functions.signature: static isc::dhcp::OptionPtr isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::optionFactory(isc::dhcp::Option::Universe u, uint16_t type, const OptionBuffer& buf)
functions.description: Creates an Option instance by invoking a previously-registered factory for the given universe and option type, initialized with the provided buffer.
requirements: u must be Option::V4 or Option::V6
A factory must have been registered for the given type in the given universe; otherwise the function throws isc::InvalidOperation
buf must contain a valid on-wire representation expected by the factory
Caller must be prepared to catch exceptions thrown by factories (e.g., malformed buffers)

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::packOptions4
functions.signature: static void isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::packOptions4(isc::util::OutputBuffer& buf, const isc::dhcp::OptionCollection& options, bool top = false, bool check = true)
functions.description: Serializes DHCPv4 options into the output buffer in on-wire format. When top is true (top-most call), emits message type first and certain options (e.g., agent info and END) last. check controls leniency toward PAD/END during packing for partial/broken packets.
requirements: buf must be a valid OutputBuffer ready for writes
options must contain valid Option objects appropriate for DHCPv4
If called recursively from Option::packOptions(), set top=true only on the first (outermost) call
Caller should handle exceptions that may be thrown for malformed/oversized options

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::splitOptions4
functions.signature: static bool isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::splitOptions4(isc::dhcp::OptionCollection& options, ScopedOptionsCopyContainer& scopedOptions, uint32_t used = 0)
functions.description: Splits oversized DHCPv4 options into multiple instances with the same code per RFC 3396, updating the container. scopedOptions holds temporary copies to maintain lifetimes during modification. used indicates bytes already consumed by a parent option, reducing allowable length.
requirements: options must be a mutable container of DHCPv4 options
scopedOptions must be provided to maintain temporary ownership of split options during the operation
used must reflect already-used buffer space of a parent option, if applicable
Caller must use the returned bool to know if changes occurred

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::packOptions6
functions.signature: static void isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::packOptions6(isc::util::OutputBuffer& buf, const isc::dhcp::OptionCollection& options)
functions.description: Serializes DHCPv6 options into the output buffer in on-wire format. Options are typically stored in ascending option code order; no special top-level logic.
requirements: buf must be a valid OutputBuffer ready for writes
options must contain valid DHCPv6 Option objects
Caller should handle exceptions on packing failures (e.g., too large or malformed options)

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::splitNtpServerOptions6
functions.description: Transforms DHCPv6 NTP server option content to one suboption per instance per RFC 5908. Updates the provided container in place.
requirements: options must contain DHCPv6 options; any NTP server option present should be well-formed
Caller should expect the container to be modified in place

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::unpackOptions6
functions.signature: static size_t isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::unpackOptions6(const OptionBuffer& buf, const std::string& option_space, isc::dhcp::OptionCollection& options, size_t* relay_msg_offset = 0, size_t* relay_msg_len = 0)
functions.description: Parses a buffer as DHCPv6 options using definitions from the given option_space and appends created Option objects to options. If relay_msg_offset/len are provided, the relay-msg is not created; instead, those outputs indicate where it resides for a subsequent parse, avoiding extra copies.
requirements: buf must contain on-wire DHCPv6 options
option_space must correspond to a space with appropriate definitions
options is an output container and will be appended to
If the same option type is defined more than once, the function throws
Option constructors can throw on malformed data; caller must handle exceptions
For partial parsing use-cases, the caller is responsible for handling incomplete data; partial parsing does not throw by itself

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::extendVendorOptions4
functions.description: Extends vendor options in DHCPv4 by expanding fused data across multiple OptionVendor or OptionVendorClass options and adding corresponding suboptions/values. Updates the container in place.
requirements: options must be a mutable DHCPv4 option container and may include vendor-related options
Caller should expect the container to be modified

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::unpackOptions4
functions.signature: static size_t isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::unpackOptions4(const OptionBuffer& buf, const std::string& option_space, isc::dhcp::OptionCollection& options, std::list<uint16_t>& deferred, bool flexible_pad_end = false)
functions.description: Parses a buffer as DHCPv4 options using definitions from the given option_space and appends created Option objects to options. Option codes to be deferred are added to deferred. If flexible_pad_end is true, codes 0 and 255 are treated as PAD and END when not defined in the option space. Returns the offset past the last parsed option or the position of DHO_END.
requirements: buf must contain on-wire DHCPv4 options
option_space must correspond to a space with appropriate definitions
options is an output container and will be appended to
deferred is an output list collecting codes whose processing is deferred
Caller should handle exceptions that may be thrown by option building routines
If flexible_pad_end is true, caller expects PAD/END leniency

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::OptionFactoryRegister
functions.signature: static void isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::OptionFactoryRegister(Option::Universe u, uint16_t type, Option::Factory * factory)
functions.description: Registers a factory method to build options for a specific universe/type so optionFactory can create them later.
requirements: u must be Option::V4 or Option::V6
type must not already be registered for the given universe; otherwise the function throws isc::BadValue
type must be within valid range and the universe must be valid; otherwise the function throws isc::BadValue
factory must be a valid function pointer for constructing the option type

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::getVendorOptionDefs
functions.signature: static const OptionDefContainerPtr isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::getVendorOptionDefs(Option::Universe u, const uint32_t vendor_id)
functions.description: Returns the container of vendor-specific option definitions for the given universe and enterprise/vendor ID.
requirements: u must be Option::V4 or Option::V6
vendor_id must identify a vendor for which definitions exist; otherwise null may be returned
Caller must check the returned pointer for null before use

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::unpackVendorOptions6
functions.signature: static size_t isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::unpackVendorOptions6(const uint32_t vendor_id, const OptionBuffer& buf, isc::dhcp::OptionCollection& options)
functions.description: Parses a buffer as DHCPv6 vendor options (per vendor_id) and appends created suboptions to options. Throws on parse failure; on success the return value is the buffer length (offset past last suboption).
requirements: vendor_id must be the enterprise number whose definitions the data conforms to
buf must contain on-wire DHCPv6 vendor options for that vendor
options is an output container and will be appended to
Caller must be prepared to catch exceptions on parse failure

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::unpackVendorOptions4
functions.signature: static size_t isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::unpackVendorOptions4(const uint32_t vendor_id, const OptionBuffer& buf, isc::dhcp::OptionCollection& options)
functions.description: Parses a buffer as DHCPv4 vendor options (per vendor_id) and appends created suboptions to options. Throws on parse failure; on success the return value is the buffer length (offset past last suboption).
requirements: vendor_id must be the enterprise number whose definitions the data conforms to
buf must contain on-wire DHCPv4 vendor options for that vendor
options is an output container and will be appended to
Caller must be prepared to catch exceptions on parse failure

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::setRuntimeOptionDefs
functions.description: Copies and stages runtime (non-standard) option definitions grouped by option spaces. Typically called during configuration load to stage changes that can later be committed or reverted.
requirements: defs must contain valid option definitions grouped by option spaces
Caller should follow with commitRuntimeOptionDefs() to make changes effective or revertRuntimeOptionDefs()/clearRuntimeOptionDefs() to discard

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::clearRuntimeOptionDefs
functions.description: Removes staged and/or committed runtime option definitions.
requirements: No arguments; effect is to clear runtime definitions
Callers should understand this may impact parsing/packing that relies on runtime definitions

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::revertRuntimeOptionDefs
functions.description: Reverts uncommitted changes to runtime option definitions (i.e., discards staged changes).
requirements: There must be prior staged changes to revert; otherwise it is a no-op

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::commitRuntimeOptionDefs
functions.description: Commits staged runtime option definitions, making them active for lookups and parsing/packing.
requirements: Caller should have previously staged definitions via setRuntimeOptionDefs()
Be aware that committing affects subsequent option lookups and parsing

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::optionSpaceToVendorId
functions.description: Converts an option space name of the form "vendor-X" (X is uint32) into the vendor ID X. Returns 0 for invalid format; 0 is not a valid vendor ID and signals error.
requirements: option_space should be formatted as "vendor-<uint32>" to succeed
Caller must treat a return value of 0 as an error indicator

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::DHO_DHCP_REQUESTED_ADDRESS_DEF
functions.description: Returns the OptionDefinition for the DHCPv4 Requested IP Address option (DHO_DHCP_REQUESTED_ADDRESS). Use to interpret or construct this option.
requirements: None beyond normal use; caller uses the returned reference read-only

functions.name: isc::dhcp::LibDHCP::DHO_DHCP_SERVER_IDENTIFIER_DEF
functions.description: Returns the OptionDefinition for the DHCPv4 Server Identifier option (DHO_DHCP_SERVER_IDENTIFIER).
requirements: None beyond normal use; caller uses the returned reference read-only
