functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionClasslessStaticRoute::OptionClasslessStaticRoute
functions.signature: isc::dhcp::OptionClasslessStaticRoute::OptionClasslessStaticRoute(OptionBufferConstIter begin, OptionBufferConstIter end, bool convenient_notation = false)
functions.description: Constructs a DHCPv4 Classless Static Route (option 121) from a buffer range. The buffer either contains on-wire binary data or a convenient-notation string, as selected by convenient_notation. May throw if parsing fails (e.g., via unpack for binary data or internal parsing for convenient notation). Intended for creating the option from received packets or configuration strings.
requirements: begin and end must form a valid iterator range over the option data (begin <= end)
When convenient_notation is false, the buffer must contain valid on-wire binary encoding per RFC 3442; otherwise unpack may throw OutOfRange if truncated
When convenient_notation is true, the buffer must contain a valid convenient-notation string (e.g., "10.0.0.0/8 - 10.2.3.1, ..."); otherwise parsing may throw BadValue
Caller must handle any exceptions thrown during construction

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionClasslessStaticRoute::clone
functions.description: Creates and returns a heap-allocated copy of this option object. Use when duplicating options without sharing state.
requirements: Caller must manage the returned OptionPtr according to project ownership semantics (shared pointer)
Safe to call on a fully constructed object

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionClasslessStaticRoute::pack
functions.signature: void isc::dhcp::OptionClasslessStaticRoute::pack(util::OutputBuffer& buf, bool check = true) const
functions.description: Serializes the option to wire format and appends it to the provided output buffer. Returns via side effects (data written to buf). May throw if header packing fails. The check flag controls option-length checking (used only in DHCPv4 paths).
requirements: buf must reference a valid, writable util::OutputBuffer
If check is true, callers should expect length verification to occur (and potential exceptions on mismatch)
Caller must handle exceptions potentially thrown by packHeader or internal packing routines
Must be called on a valid, initialized option instance

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionClasslessStaticRoute::unpack
functions.description: Parses on-wire binary option data from the provided iterator range and populates this option’s internal representation. Used when decoding received packets.
requirements: begin and end must define a valid readable range of binary option data (begin <= end)
Provided data must not be truncated; otherwise OutOfRange is thrown
Subnet mask width values in the data must be valid; otherwise BadValue is thrown
Caller must handle exceptions (OutOfRange, BadValue) on malformed input
Should only be used for binary on-wire data (not convenient-notation strings)

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionClasslessStaticRoute::toText
functions.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the option, optionally prefixed with a number of spaces equal to indent. Useful for logging and diagnostics.
requirements: indent is an integer; behavior for negative values is unspecified in the header
May be called on any valid instance

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionClasslessStaticRoute::len
functions.description: Returns the total length in octets of the option, including the DHCPv4 option header (not just the payload).
requirements: May be called on any valid instance
Returned length reflects current internal static routes encoding

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::OptionCustom
functions.description: Constructs an OptionCustom to be sent, initializing buffers for all defined fields per the supplied OptionDefinition. For fixed-size fields, buffers are sized appropriately; for variable-size fields, empty buffers are created. Use this when creating options for outgoing DHCP messages.
requirements: def must describe the option’s structure (types/order) and must be compatible with how this instance will be used.
u must correctly indicate the protocol universe (V4 or V6) for this option.
The created buffers follow the data types declared in def; callers must subsequently write data consistent with those types.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::clone
functions.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of this OptionCustom as an OptionPtr. Use when duplicating options for independent modification or storage.
requirements: The returned pointer must be managed by the caller as a shared pointer (OptionPtr).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::addArrayDataField
functions.description: Appends a new array element buffer and stores an IPv4/IPv6 address in it. Intended for options defined as arrays (last record field may be array).
requirements: The option must be defined as an array (definition_.getArrayType() true); otherwise InvalidOperation is thrown (via checkArrayType).
The option’s element type (or last record field type for record arrays) must be an address-compatible type; mismatch results in InvalidDataType (by internal checks).
address must be a valid IOAddress per library semantics; invalid addresses can cause BadDataTypeCast in similar write operations (inferred).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::getDataFieldsNum
functions.description: Returns the number of data field buffers currently held by the option. For arrays, this is the number of array elements; for non-arrays, it matches the number of fields in the definition.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::readAddress
functions.description: Reads the buffer at index as an IPv4/IPv6 address and returns it.
requirements: index must be within [0, getDataFieldsNum()); otherwise OutOfRange is thrown.
The field’s declared type must be an address; otherwise BadDataTypeCast may be raised during conversion (inferred).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writeAddress
functions.signature: void isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writeAddress(const asiolink::IOAddress& address, const uint32_t index = 0)
functions.description: Encodes and writes an IPv4/IPv6 address into the buffer at index.
requirements: index must be within [0, getDataFieldsNum()); otherwise OutOfRange is thrown.
The field’s declared type must be an address; a mismatch or invalid address results in isc::dhcp::BadDataTypeCast.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::readBinary
functions.signature: const isc::dhcp::OptionBuffer& isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::readBinary(const uint32_t index = 0) const
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the raw buffer at index for fields defined as binary/opaque data.
requirements: index must be within range; otherwise OutOfRange is thrown.
Callers must not mutate the returned buffer (const reference).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writeBinary
functions.signature: void isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writeBinary(const isc::dhcp::OptionBuffer& buf, const uint32_t index = 0)
functions.description: Replaces the buffer at index with the provided binary data. Use for fields defined as binary/opaque types.
requirements: index should refer to an existing field buffer; behavior otherwise is invalid (inferred from class pattern).
buf must conform to the field’s expected type/length per definition_ (inferred).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::readTuple
functions.description: Reads an opaque-data tuple (length + data) from the buffer at index and returns it as a std::string.
requirements: index must be within range; otherwise OutOfRange is thrown.
The field must be defined as an opaque-data tuple; otherwise a type conversion error will occur (inferred).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::readTuple
functions.signature: void isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::readTuple(isc::dhcp::OpaqueDataTuple& tuple, const uint32_t index = 0) const
functions.description: Reads an opaque-data tuple (length + data) from the buffer at index into the supplied OpaqueDataTuple object.
requirements: index must be within range; otherwise OutOfRange is thrown.
The field must be defined as an opaque-data tuple (inferred).
tuple must be a valid object ready to receive data.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writeTuple
functions.signature: void isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writeTuple(const std::string& value, const uint32_t index = 0)
functions.description: Encodes the given string as an opaque-data tuple (length + data) and writes it into the buffer at index.
requirements: index must refer to a valid field buffer (inferred).
The field must be defined as an opaque-data tuple (inferred).
value length must be valid for the tuple representation (inferred).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writeTuple
functions.signature: void isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writeTuple(const isc::dhcp::OpaqueDataTuple& value, const uint32_t index = 0)
functions.description: Writes the provided OpaqueDataTuple (length + data) into the buffer at index.
requirements: index must refer to a valid field buffer (inferred).
The field must be defined as an opaque-data tuple (inferred).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::readBoolean
functions.description: Reads the buffer at index as a boolean value.
requirements: index must be within range; otherwise OutOfRange is thrown.
The field’s type must be boolean; type mismatches cause conversion errors (inferred).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writeBoolean
functions.signature: void isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writeBoolean(const bool value, const uint32_t index = 0)
functions.description: Writes a boolean value into the buffer at index.
requirements: index must be within range; otherwise OutOfRange is thrown.
The field’s type must be boolean (inferred).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::readFqdn
functions.description: Reads the buffer at index as a fully-qualified domain name and returns it as a string.
requirements: index must be within range; otherwise OutOfRange is thrown.
Buffer must contain a valid FQDN encoding; otherwise isc::dhcp::BadDataTypeCast is thrown.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writeFqdn
functions.signature: void isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writeFqdn(const std::string& fqdn, const uint32_t index = 0)
functions.description: Writes an FQDN into the buffer at index using the appropriate DHCP FQDN encoding.
requirements: index must be within range; otherwise OutOfRange is thrown.
fqdn must be a valid FQDN string per expected encoding (inferred).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::readInteger
functions.signature: template<typename T> T isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::readInteger(const uint32_t index = 0) const
functions.description: Template that reads the buffer at index as an integer of type T and returns it. Validates that T is a supported integer type and matches the field’s defined type (including record/array semantics).
requirements: index must be within [0, getDataFieldsNum()); otherwise OutOfRange is thrown.
T must be a supported integer type; otherwise isc::dhcp::InvalidDataType is thrown.

T must match the field’s defined OptionDataType (for records, uses the field at index; for record arrays, the last record field for indices beyond fixed portion); mismatch throws isc::dhcp::InvalidDataType.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writeInteger
functions.signature: template<typename T> void isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writeInteger(const T value, const uint32_t index = 0)
functions.description: Template that writes an integer of type T into the buffer at index. Validates that T is a supported integer type and matches the field’s defined type before encoding.
requirements: index must be within [0, getDataFieldsNum()); otherwise OutOfRange is thrown.
T must be a supported integer type; otherwise isc::dhcp::InvalidDataType is thrown.
T must match the field’s defined OptionDataType per the OptionDefinition/record rules; mismatch throws isc::dhcp::InvalidDataType.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::readPrefix
functions.description: Reads the buffer at index as a variable-length prefix (length + value) and returns it as a PrefixTuple.
requirements: index must be within range; otherwise OutOfRange is thrown.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writePrefix
functions.signature: void isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writePrefix(const isc::dhcp::PrefixLen& prefix_len, const asiolink::IOAddress& prefix, const uint32_t index = 0)
functions.description: Writes a variable-length prefix (length + address prefix) into the buffer at index.
requirements: index must be within range; otherwise OutOfRange is thrown.
prefix_len and prefix must form a valid prefix per the field’s type (inferred).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::readPsid
functions.description: Reads the buffer at index as a PSID length/value tuple and returns it.
requirements: index must be within range; otherwise OutOfRange is thrown.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writePsid
functions.signature: void isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writePsid(const isc::dhcp::PSIDLen& psid_len, const isc::dhcp::PSID& psid, const uint32_t index = 0)
functions.description: Writes a PSID length/value tuple into the buffer at index.
requirements: psid_len must be valid and psid must be within 0..2^(psid_len); otherwise isc::dhcp::BadDataTypeCast is thrown.
index must be within range; otherwise OutOfRange is thrown.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::readString
functions.description: Reads the buffer at index as a string value and returns it.
requirements: index must be within range; otherwise OutOfRange is thrown.
The field must be a string-compatible type per definition_ (inferred).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writeString
functions.signature: void isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::writeString(const std::string& text, const uint32_t index = 0)
functions.description: Writes a string value into the buffer at index.
requirements: index must refer to a valid field buffer (inferred).
The field must be a string-compatible type per definition_ (inferred).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::pack
functions.signature: virtual void isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::pack(isc::util::OutputBuffer& buf, bool check = true) const
functions.description: Serializes this option (including header) into the provided OutputBuffer in wire format. If check is false, permits DHCPv4 options larger than 255 bytes.
requirements: buf must be a valid, writable OutputBuffer.
If u is DHCPv4 and check is true, the encoded option size must not exceed 255 bytes (inferred from comment).
Option content must be consistent with its OptionDefinition for correct serialization.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::unpack
functions.description: Parses received option data from [begin,end) and populates this option’s internal buffers according to its OptionDefinition.
requirements: [begin,end) must delimit exactly the option’s data; otherwise parsing errors or exceptions may occur (inferred).
The OptionDefinition associated with this instance must match the data layout.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::toText
functions.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of this option, optionally prefixed with indent spaces.
requirements: indent should be non-negative (inferred).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::len
functions.description: Returns the total wire length of the option including the DHCPv4/DHCPv6 option header.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::initialize
functions.signature: void isc::dhcp::OptionCustom::initialize(const isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter first, const isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter last)
functions.description: Replaces this option’s content by copying from [first,last). Resizes internal buffers to match the copied data per the OptionDefinition.
requirements: [first,last) must delimit the complete set of field data expected by the OptionDefinition; otherwise range/parse errors may be thrown (inferred).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::InvalidDataType::InvalidDataType
functions.signature: isc::dhcp::InvalidDataType::InvalidDataType(const char* file, size_t line, const char* what)
functions.description: Constructs an InvalidDataType exception indicating an unsupported/invalid option data type was used. Intended to be thrown by helpers when a template parameter or runtime type is not supported.
requirements: file should point to a C-string with source file name (conventional).
line should be the source line number (conventional).
what should describe the error; must be a valid C-string.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::BadDataTypeCast::BadDataTypeCast
functions.signature: isc::dhcp::BadDataTypeCast::BadDataTypeCast(const char* file, size_t line, const char* what)
functions.description: Constructs a BadDataTypeCast exception used when decoding/casting option payload to a target type fails (e.g., truncated buffer, invalid encoding).
requirements: file should point to a C-string with source file name (conventional).
line should be the source line number (conventional).
what should describe the error; must be a valid C-string.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::getDataType
functions.description: Maps a textual data type name to its OptionDataType enum value. Used when parsing option definitions from configs.
requirements: data_type must be a recognized type name as understood by the library; unknown names will result in an error (details not shown here).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::getDataTypeName
functions.description: Returns the canonical string name for a given OptionDataType enum value.
requirements: data_type should be a valid OptionDataType; unknown/unsupported values may cause an error (per implementation).
Returned reference remains valid as it refers to an internal singleton-owned string.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::getDataTypeLen
functions.description: Returns the fixed on-the-wire size (in bytes) for a data type where applicable; returns 0 for variable-length types. IPv4 and IPv6 addresses return 4 and 16 respectively.
requirements: Callers must not assume non-zero for variable-length types (e.g., string, binary).
Only use the result to size buffers for fixed-size encodings.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::readAddress
functions.signature: static asiolink::IOAddress isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::readAddress(const std::vector<uint8_t>& buf, const short family)
functions.description: Reads an IPv4 or IPv6 address from buf according to family (AF_INET or AF_INET6) and returns it as IOAddress.
requirements: family must be AF_INET (requires at least 4 bytes) or AF_INET6 (requires at least 16 bytes).
buf must contain the full address; truncated data throws isc::dhcp::BadDataTypeCast.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::writeAddress
functions.signature: static void isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::writeAddress(const asiolink::IOAddress& address, std::vector<uint8_t>& buf)
functions.description: Appends the IPv4/IPv6 address bytes of address to buf.
requirements: address must represent either a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.
buf is an output buffer and will be appended to.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::writeBinary
functions.signature: static void isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::writeBinary(const std::string& hex_str, std::vector<uint8_t>& buf)
functions.description: Parses a hex-encoded string (no 0x prefix) and appends the corresponding binary bytes to buf.
requirements: hex_str should contain only hexadecimal digits (0-9, a-f, A-F).
Encoding specifics such as required even length are not documented here; invalid input is expected to result in an error (implementation-defined).
buf is an output buffer and will be appended to.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::readTuple
functions.signature: static std::string isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::readTuple(const std::vector<uint8_t>& buf, OpaqueDataTuple::LengthFieldType lengthfieldtype)
functions.description: Reads an opaque data tuple (length + value) from buf and returns the value as a string. Length field size is specified (1 byte for DHCPv4 or 2 bytes for DHCPv6).
requirements: lengthfieldtype must be OpaqueDataTuple::LENGTH_1_BYTE or LENGTH_2_BYTES as appropriate for the wire format.
buf must contain the entire length field and the indicated number of value bytes; truncated input throws isc::dhcp::BadDataTypeCast.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::writeTuple
functions.signature: static void isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::writeTuple(const std::string& value, OpaqueDataTuple::LengthFieldType lengthfieldtype, std::vector<uint8_t>& buf)
functions.description: Writes a length-prefixed opaque data tuple to buf using the specified length field width and the provided string value.
requirements: lengthfieldtype must match the intended protocol (LENGTH_1_BYTE for DHCPv4, LENGTH_2_BYTES for DHCPv6).
value length must fit in the chosen length field; otherwise behavior is implementation-defined (likely error).
buf is an output buffer and will be appended to.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::getTupleLenFieldType
functions.description: Returns the default tuple length field type for the given DHCP universe: 1 octet for V4, 2 octets for V6.
requirements: u must be a valid Option::Universe (V4 or V6).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::readBool
functions.description: Reads a boolean encoded as a single byte from buf where 1 = true and 0 = false.
requirements: buf must contain at least 1 byte.
Value must be 0 or 1; otherwise throws isc::dhcp::BadDataTypeCast.
Truncated input throws isc::dhcp::BadDataTypeCast.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::writeBool
functions.signature: static void isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::writeBool(const bool value, std::vector<uint8_t>& buf)
functions.description: Appends a single byte to buf encoding value as 1 (true) or 0 (false).
requirements: buf is an output buffer and will be appended to.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::readFqdn
functions.description: Parses an RFC1035 wire-format domain name from buf and returns it as a text FQDN.
requirements: buf must hold a valid RFC1035 name (labels with length octets, proper termination).
Invalid, empty, truncated, or malformed names throw isc::dhcp::BadDataTypeCast.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::writeFqdn
functions.signature: static void isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::writeFqdn(const std::string& fqdn, std::vector<uint8_t>& buf, const bool downcase = false)
functions.description: Encodes fqdn into RFC1035 wire format and appends it to buf. Optionally downcases labels before encoding.
requirements: fqdn must be a syntactically valid fully qualified domain name (per RFC1035 section 3.1).
If downcase is true, callers should expect the stored name to be lowercase.
Invalid FQDNs cause isc::dhcp::BadDataTypeCast.
buf is an output buffer and will be appended to.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::getLabelCount
functions.description: Returns the number of labels in a textual domain name. Returns 0 if the input is empty.
requirements: text_name must be a well-formed domain name string; malformed input throws isc::dhcp::BadDataTypeCast.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::readPrefix
functions.description: Reads a prefix length (in bits) and the corresponding prefix value from buf. The prefix is padded with zeros to the next byte boundary if needed and returned as (PrefixLen, IOAddress).
requirements: buf must contain at least 1 byte for the length plus enough bytes for the indicated prefix length (ceil(length/8)).
Malformed or truncated input results in an error (implementation throws on bad data).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::writePrefix
functions.signature: static void isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::writePrefix(const isc::dhcp::PrefixLen& prefix_len, const asiolink::IOAddress& prefix, std::vector<uint8_t>& buf)
functions.description: Writes a prefix tuple to buf as a 1-byte length followed by the variable-length prefix bytes (zero-padded to a byte boundary as needed).
requirements: prefix_len must be in the range 0..128 (per documentation).
prefix must be a valid address compatible with the intended encoding.
buf is an output buffer and will be appended to.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::readPsid
functions.description: Reads a PSID tuple from buf: one byte of PSID length followed by two bytes containing the zero-padded PSID value. Returns (PSIDLen, PSID).
requirements: buf must contain at least 3 bytes.
PSID length must be in 0..16 and the value must be consistent with that length; otherwise throws isc::dhcp::BadDataTypeCast.
Truncated input throws isc::dhcp::BadDataTypeCast.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::writePsid
functions.signature: static void isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::writePsid(const isc::dhcp::PSIDLen& psid_len, const isc::dhcp::PSID& psid, std::vector<uint8_t>& buf)
functions.description: Appends a PSID tuple to buf as a 1-byte length and a 2-byte value with the specified number of significant bits followed by zero padding.
requirements: psid_len must be in 0..16.
psid must be in the range [0, 2^(psid_len)-1].
buf is an output buffer and will be appended to.
Invalid lengths/values cause isc::dhcp::BadDataTypeCast.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::readString
functions.description: Reads a string from buf, trimming trailing NULL bytes to comply with RFC 2132 section 2. If the payload is only NULLs, throws.
requirements: buf may contain trailing NULs which will be removed.
If all bytes are NUL, throws isc::dhcp::OutOfRange.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::writeString
functions.signature: static void isc::dhcp::OptionDataTypeUtil::writeString(const std::string& value, std::vector<uint8_t>& buf)
functions.description: Writes a UTF-8 encoded string value to buf (no implicit length prefix).
requirements: value should be valid UTF-8 per documentation intent.
buf is an output buffer and will be appended to.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::PSIDLen::PSIDLen
functions.description: Default-constructs a PSID length wrapper with length 0.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::PSIDLen::PSIDLen

functions.name: isc::dhcp::PSID::asUint16

functions.name: isc::dhcp::PrefixLen::PrefixLen
functions.description: Default-constructs a prefix length wrapper with length 0.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::PrefixLen::PrefixLen
functions.description: Constructs a prefix length wrapper. Documentation indicates valid range is 0..128.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::PrefixLen::asUint8
functions.description: Returns the prefix length as an 8-bit value.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::PrefixLen::asUnsigned
functions.description: Returns the prefix length as an unsigned int, convenient for logging.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::OptionDefinition

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::create
functions.signature: static isc::dhcp::OptionDefinitionPtr isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::create(const std::string& name, const uint16_t code, const std::string& space, const std::string& type, const bool array_type = false)

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::equals
functions.description: Compares two option definitions for equality (name, code, type, array flag, encapsulated space, record fields, and other relevant state).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::operator!=

requirements: other must be a valid OptionDefinition reference.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::getArrayType

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::getCode

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::getName

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::getRecordFields

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::getOptionSpaceName

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::getType

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::getContext

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::contextToElement

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::validate
functions.description: Validates the option definition. Throws if invalid. Not called internally; callers must validate before using to create options.
requirements: Call before using optionFactory to avoid undefined behavior.
Throws isc::dhcp::MalformedOptionDefinition if invalid.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::optionFactory
functions.signature: isc::dhcp::OptionPtr isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::optionFactory(isc::dhcp::Option::Universe u, uint16_t type, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter begin, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter end, bool convenient_notation = false) const
functions.description: Creates a DHCP option instance from a buffer range according to this definition. Supports convenient_notation where input is a user-friendly string representation understood by specific option types.

u must match the intended universe (V4 or V6).
type must be the desired option code to construct.
begin/end must delimit the exact option payload buffer range for this option type.
May throw isc::dhcp::InvalidOptionValue if data is invalid.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryAddrList4
functions.signature: static isc::dhcp::OptionPtr isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryAddrList4(uint16_t type, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter begin, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter end)

type must be the desired option code.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryAddrList6
functions.signature: static isc::dhcp::OptionPtr isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryAddrList6(uint16_t type, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter begin, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter end)
functions.description: Creates an option carrying a list of IPv6 addresses parsed from the buffer range.
requirements: The buffer length between begin and end must be a multiple of IPv6 address length (16 bytes); otherwise throws isc::OutOfRange.
type must be the desired option code.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryEmpty
functions.description: Creates an empty option (no payload) for the given universe and code.
requirements: u must be V4 or V6.
type must be the desired option code.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryGeneric
functions.signature: static isc::dhcp::OptionPtr isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryGeneric(isc::dhcp::Option::Universe u, uint16_t type, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter begin, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter end)
functions.description: Creates a generic (raw) option from the given buffer range for the specified universe and code.
requirements: u must be V4 or V6.
begin/end must delimit the payload range for the option.
type must be the desired option code.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryIA6
functions.signature: static isc::dhcp::OptionPtr isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryIA6(uint16_t type, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter begin, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter end)
functions.description: Creates a DHCPv6 IA (Identity Association) option. Expected payload size is exactly 12 bytes.
requirements: The buffer length must be exactly 12 bytes; otherwise throws isc::OutOfRange.
type must be the IA option code.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryIAAddr6
functions.signature: static isc::dhcp::OptionPtr isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryIAAddr6(uint16_t type, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter begin, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter end)
functions.description: Creates a DHCPv6 IAADDR option. Expected payload size is exactly 24 bytes.
requirements: The buffer length must be exactly 24 bytes; otherwise throws isc::OutOfRange.
type must be the IAADDR option code.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryIAPrefix6
functions.signature: static isc::dhcp::OptionPtr isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryIAPrefix6(uint16_t type, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter begin, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter end)
functions.description: Creates a DHCPv6 IAPREFIX option. Expected minimum payload size is 25 bytes.
requirements: The buffer length must be at least 25 bytes; otherwise throws isc::OutOfRange.
type must be the IAPREFIX option code.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryOpaqueDataTuples
functions.signature: static isc::dhcp::OptionPtr isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryOpaqueDataTuples(isc::dhcp::Option::Universe u, uint16_t type, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter begin, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter end)
functions.description: Creates an option with a list of opaque data tuples. Tuple length field type is implied by the universe (1 byte for V4, 2 bytes for V6).
requirements: u must be V4 or V6.
begin/end must delimit a buffer formed by concatenated tuples with valid length fields.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryInteger
functions.signature: template<typename T> static isc::dhcp::OptionPtr isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryInteger(isc::dhcp::Option::Universe u, uint16_t type, const std::string& encapsulated_space, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter begin, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter end)
functions.description: Template factory that creates an integer-valued option and sets its encapsulated space. Unpacks the value from the buffer range according to integer type T.
requirements: T must be an integral type supported by OptionInt (one of intX_t/uintX_t).
u must be V4 or V6.
begin/end must delimit exactly the size of T for a single integer payload; otherwise may throw isc::OutOfRange.
encapsulated_space names the sub-option space; may be empty to indicate none.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryIntegerArray
functions.signature: template<typename T> static isc::dhcp::OptionPtr isc::dhcp::OptionDefinition::factoryIntegerArray(isc::dhcp::Option::Universe u, uint16_t type, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter begin, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter end)
functions.description: Template factory that creates an option carrying an array of integers of type T parsed from the buffer range.
requirements: T must be an integral type supported by OptionIntArray (one of intX_t/uintX_t).
u must be V4 or V6.
The buffer length between begin and end must be a multiple of sizeof(T); otherwise may throw isc::OutOfRange.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionDefSpaceContainer::addItem
functions.description: Adds an option definition to the space container using the definition’s own option space name, preventing mismatches between definition and container.
requirements: def must be a valid, non-null OptionDefinitionPtr.
def->getOptionSpaceName() must correspond to an existing/managed space key of this container (as required by BaseOptionDefSpaceContainer::addItem).

functions.name: OptionInt::OptionInt
functions.signature: template<typename T> isc::dhcp::OptionInt<T>::OptionInt(isc::dhcp::Option::Universe u, uint16_t type, T value)
functions.description: Constructs a DHCP option carrying a single integer value of type T. Sets the encapsulated option space based on the universe (V4/V6). Validates at runtime that T is one of the supported integer types. Typical usage: create an OptionInt<T> with a universe, option code, and value to later serialize or attach as a suboption.
requirements: Template parameter T must be an integer type supported by OptionDataTypeTraits (1, 2, or 4-byte signed/unsigned integer). Otherwise throws isc::dhcp::InvalidDataType.
Parameter u must be a valid universe value (isc::dhcp::Option::V4 or isc::dhcp::Option::V6).
The option code 'type' must be a valid option code for the given universe (no explicit range is enforced here).
On construction, if T is not recognized as an integer by OptionDataTypeTraits, the constructor throws isc::dhcp::InvalidDataType.
Encapsulated option space is set to DHCP4_OPTION_SPACE for V4 and DHCP6_OPTION_SPACE for V6 automatically.

functions.name: OptionInt::clone
functions.signature: template<typename T> virtual isc::dhcp::OptionPtr isc::dhcp::OptionInt<T>::clone() const
functions.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of this OptionInt<T> (including its value and suboptions) as a polymorphic OptionPtr. Use when duplicating options without sharing state.
requirements: The returned pointer must be managed by the caller as a shared pointer (isc::dhcp::OptionPtr).
Object must be in a valid constructed state when calling clone().

functions.name: OptionInt::pack
functions.signature: template<typename T> virtual void isc::dhcp::OptionInt<T>::pack(isc::util::OutputBuffer& buf, bool check = true) const
functions.description: Serializes the option into DHCP wire format into the provided OutputBuffer. Writes the option header, the integer value (big-endian), and any suboptions. The 'check' flag controls v4 length checking (when false, allows options >255 bytes for v4).
requirements: The object must have been constructed with a supported integer T (1, 2, or 4 bytes); otherwise packing throws isc::dhcp::InvalidDataType.
The provided isc::util::OutputBuffer 'buf' must be valid and writable.
If check is true for DHCPv4, the total length must satisfy v4 constraints (else an error may be raised by header packing).
Caller should ensure appropriate universe (V4/V6) and option code are set prior to packing.

functions.name: OptionInt::unpack
functions.signature: template<typename T> virtual void isc::dhcp::OptionInt<T>::unpack(isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter begin, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter end)
functions.description: Parses the integer value from the buffer range [begin, end) in network byte order and then unpacks any trailing suboptions. Throws if the range is shorter than sizeof(T) or if T is not a supported integer size.
requirements: The input buffer range [begin, end) must contain at least sizeof(T) bytes; otherwise throws isc::OutOfRange.
Iterators 'begin' and 'end' must be valid and refer to a contiguous memory block containing the option data.
Template parameter T must be a supported integer size (1, 2, or 4 bytes); otherwise throws isc::dhcp::InvalidDataType.
Any bytes after the first sizeof(T) are treated as suboptions and must form a valid suboptions block for unpackOptions.

functions.name: OptionInt::setValue
functions.description: Sets the stored integer value of the option. Use to update the option’s payload prior to packing or further processing.
requirements: The provided value must be representable by T (compile-time/type requirement).
The object must be validly constructed prior to calling setValue().

functions.name: OptionInt::getValue
functions.description: Returns the stored integer value of the option.
requirements: Object must be validly constructed; no additional runtime constraints are specified.

functions.name: OptionInt::len
functions.signature: template<typename T> virtual uint16_t isc::dhcp::OptionInt<T>::len() const
functions.description: Computes and returns the total on-the-wire length of the option, including header, the integer value (sizeof(T)), and all suboptions.
requirements: No explicit caller requirements; function is const and does not throw under normal circumstances.

functions.name: OptionInt::toText
functions.signature: template<typename T> virtual std::string isc::dhcp::OptionInt<T>::toText(int indent = 0) const
functions.description: Returns a human-readable textual representation of the option, including header info, the integer value (printed as a number even for 1-byte types), the data type name, and any suboptions. The indent parameter controls the number of leading spaces.
requirements: No explicit constraints on 'indent' are enforced; it is used as a count of spaces for formatting.
The object must be validly constructed; suboptions, if present, should be well-formed for accurate text output.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionIntArray::OptionIntArray
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
isc::dhcp::OptionIntArray<T>::OptionIntArray(const isc::dhcp::Option::Universe u, uint16_t type)
functions.description: Constructs an empty DHCP option carrying an array of integers of type T for the specified universe (V4 or V6) and option type. Valid only for integer T of size 1, 2, or 4 bytes. Values can be appended later via addValue or set as a whole via setValues. Sub-options may be attached via the base API but are ignored during packing/unpacking for this array option.
requirements: Template parameter T must be an integer type supported by OptionDataTypeTraits (one of: uint8_t, uint16_t, uint32_t, int8_t, int16_t, int32_t); otherwise constructor throws isc::dhcp::InvalidDataType.
u must be either isc::dhcp::Option::V4 or isc::dhcp::Option::V6 (per Option::Universe).
type is the numeric option code expected by the target DHCP universe.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionIntArray::clone
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
virtual isc::dhcp::OptionPtr isc::dhcp::OptionIntArray<T>::clone() const
functions.description: Creates a deep copy of this OptionIntArray, returning it as an OptionPtr. Intended for polymorphic duplication of options when building or transforming DHCP messages.
requirements: The returned pointer must be managed by the caller according to project conventions (smart pointer OptionPtr semantics).
T is the same template parameter as the source instance; cloning preserves all values and metadata of the option.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionIntArray::addValue
functions.description: Appends a single integer value of type T to the option's value array. Use repeatedly to build the payload before packing.
requirements: value must be representable in type T; no further range checking is performed by this function.
Consider overall option size limits in the target universe when accumulating values (IPv4 options commonly limited to 255 bytes unless pack is called with check=false).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionIntArray::pack
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
virtual void isc::dhcp::OptionIntArray<T>::pack(isc::util::OutputBuffer& buf, bool check = true) const
functions.description: Serializes the option to wire format into the provided OutputBuffer, writing the option header and the array of integer values in network byte order. Sub-options are intentionally not packed for array-type options.
requirements: Template parameter T must correspond to an integer type of size 1, 2, or 4 bytes; otherwise the function throws isc::dhcp::InvalidDataType.
buf must be a valid OutputBuffer ready to receive data.

If targeting DHCPv4 and the resulting option would exceed standard size limits, callers may set check=false to bypass size checks enforced by packHeader (behavior of oversize options depends on the rest of the stack).
Values must have been set (via addValue/setValues) prior to packing if a non-empty payload is desired.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionIntArray::unpack
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
virtual void isc::dhcp::OptionIntArray<T>::unpack(isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter begin, isc::dhcp::OptionBufferConstIter end)
functions.description: Parses option data from the byte range [begin, end), reading integers of type T in network byte order into the internal values array. Sub-options are not unpacked for array-type options.
requirements: The iterator range [begin, end) must not be empty; otherwise throws isc::OutOfRange.
The total number of bytes in [begin, end) must be an exact multiple of sizeof(T); otherwise throws isc::OutOfRange.
Template parameter T must be an integer type with size 1, 2, or 4 bytes; otherwise throws isc::dhcp::InvalidDataType.
begin and end must be valid iterators into the same buffer; advancing by sizeof(T) per element must not overrun end.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionIntArray::getValues
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
const std::vector<T>& isc::dhcp::OptionIntArray<T>::getValues() const
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the internal vector of integer values carried by the option. Useful for read-only inspection after construction or unpacking.
requirements: The returned reference remains valid as long as the OptionIntArray instance remains alive and its internal container is not modified by non-const methods.
Caller cannot modify the returned container (const reference).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionIntArray::setValues
functions.description: Replaces the option's internal array of values with the provided collection. Subsequent pack() will serialize these values.
requirements: values must contain elements of type T only.
Consider overall option size limits for the target universe when supplying large vectors (IPv4 options often limited to 255 bytes unless pack is called with check=false).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionIntArray::len
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
virtual uint16_t isc::dhcp::OptionIntArray<T>::len() const
functions.description: Computes the total wire length of the option, including the DHCP option header (V4 or V6) and the payload (values_.size() * sizeof(T)), plus the lengths of any attached sub-options (although sub-options are ignored by pack/unpack for this array type).
requirements: No arguments; relies on the current universe (V4 or V6) and current values/suboptions.
Be aware of potential inconsistency: sub-options contribute to len(), but are not serialized by pack() for this array type.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionIntArray::toText
functions.signature:
template<typename T>
virtual std::string isc::dhcp::OptionIntArray<T>::toText(int indent = 0) const
functions.description: Returns a human-readable string describing the option: header fields followed by each value and its data type name. For 1-byte types, values are cast to int to avoid char-like printing. Intended for logging and debugging.
requirements: indent specifies the number of leading spaces to prepend; must be non-negative for sensible formatting (not enforced).
Caller should not rely on this textual format for parsing; it is for diagnostics.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionOpaqueDataTuples::OptionOpaqueDataTuples
functions.signature: isc::dhcp::OptionOpaqueDataTuples::OptionOpaqueDataTuples(isc::dhcp::Option::Universe u, const uint16_t type, isc::dhcp::OpaqueDataTuple::LengthFieldType length_field_type = isc::dhcp::OpaqueDataTuple::LENGTH_EMPTY)
functions.description: Constructs an OptionOpaqueDataTuples for the given DHCP universe and option code, configuring how tuple length fields are interpreted. Intended for building options such as DHCPv6 Bootfile Parameters (60) programmatically before packing to wire format.
requirements: u must be a valid isc::dhcp::Option::Universe (v4 or v6).
type must be a valid DHCP option code for the selected universe.
length_field_type determines the size of each tuple's length field; if left as LENGTH_EMPTY, the class will infer it from the universe (details of inference are not documented here).
Object is created empty (no tuples) and can be populated via addTuple or setTuple.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionOpaqueDataTuples::clone
functions.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of this option as an OptionPtr. Useful when duplicating options while preserving contained tuples and metadata.
requirements: Caller must check the returned pointer for validity before use if their environment requires (no specific error mechanism documented; typical behavior is to return a non-null smart pointer).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionOpaqueDataTuples::pack
functions.signature: virtual void isc::dhcp::OptionOpaqueDataTuples::pack(isc::util::OutputBuffer& buf, bool check = true) const
functions.description: Serializes the option (including its header) into the given OutputBuffer in wire format, emitting all stored tuples. If check is false, permits DHCPv4 options larger than 255 bytes.
requirements: buf must be a valid, writable isc::util::OutputBuffer reference.
If check is true (default), standard size checks apply; if false, packing allows options larger than 255 bytes for DHCPv4.
The object must contain tuples whose encoding matches the configured length_field_type and universe; otherwise packing may throw or produce invalid output (exact error behavior not specified).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionOpaqueDataTuples::unpack
functions.description: Parses on-wire bytes in [begin, end) and initializes this option's internal tuple collection according to the configured universe and length field type.
requirements: [begin, end) must be a valid input range over the option payload bytes to parse.
Buffer contents must follow the encoded tuple format for this option (sequence of length fields plus data).
May throw on malformed or inconsistent data; callers should be prepared to handle exceptions.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionOpaqueDataTuples::addTuple
functions.description: Appends an opaque data tuple to this option’s tuple list. Validates that the tuple’s type matches the option’s universe.
requirements: tuple must have a type consistent with this option's universe; otherwise isc::BadValue is thrown.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionOpaqueDataTuples::setTuple
functions.signature: void isc::dhcp::OptionOpaqueDataTuples::setTuple(const size_t at, const isc::dhcp::OpaqueDataTuple& tuple)
functions.description: Replaces the tuple at the specified index with the provided tuple, validating the tuple’s type against the option’s universe.
requirements: at must be within the current tuple index range [0, getTuplesNum()). Otherwise isc::OutOfRange is thrown.
tuple must have a type consistent with this option's universe; otherwise isc::BadValue is thrown.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionOpaqueDataTuples::getTuple
functions.description: Returns a copy of the tuple at the specified index.
requirements: at must be within the current tuple index range [0, getTuplesNum()). Otherwise isc::OutOfRange is thrown.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionOpaqueDataTuples::getTuplesNum
functions.description: Returns the number of opaque data tuples currently stored in the option.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionOpaqueDataTuples::getTuples
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the collection of tuples carried by this option.
requirements: The returned reference remains valid as long as the OptionOpaqueDataTuples object is alive and its internal storage is not invalidated by non-const methods (adding/removing/replacing tuples may invalidate iterators/references according to std::vector rules).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionOpaqueDataTuples::hasTuple
functions.description: Checks whether a tuple whose string representation equals tuple_str exists within this option.
requirements: tuple_str is matched against the tuple’s string representation; exact comparison semantics (e.g., encoding, case sensitivity) are not further documented here and are assumed to be exact string match.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionOpaqueDataTuples::len
functions.description: Returns the full length of the option in bytes, including the option header and all encoded tuples.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionOpaqueDataTuples::toText
functions.description: Returns a human-readable textual representation of the option, optionally prefixed with indent spaces.
requirements: indent specifies the number of leading spaces; behavior for negative values is not documented (treat as unspecified).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::InvalidOptionSpace::InvalidOptionSpace
functions.signature: isc::dhcp::InvalidOptionSpace::InvalidOptionSpace(const char* file, size_t line, const char* what)
functions.description: Constructs an InvalidOptionSpace exception object describing an invalid option space condition. Typically used via throw when an option space name fails validation. Stores file, line, and message and delegates to isc::Exception base.
requirements: file must be a valid pointer to a null-terminated C-string describing the source file (inferred from const char*).
what must be a valid pointer to a null-terminated C-string with a human-readable error message (inferred from const char*).
line should be the source line number associated with the error (size_t).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionSpace::OptionSpace
functions.signature: isc::dhcp::OptionSpace::OptionSpace(const std::string& name, const bool vendor_space = false)
functions.description: Constructs a DHCP option space with the given name. Optionally marks it as vendor-specific when vendor_space is true. Validates the name using OptionSpace::validateName and throws InvalidOptionSpace on failure.
requirements: name must be non-empty and contain only letters (a–z, A–Z), digits (0–9), underscores (_), or dashes (-); otherwise InvalidOptionSpace is thrown.
Callers should be prepared to catch isc::dhcp::InvalidOptionSpace on invalid names.
vendor_space indicates whether the space is vendor specific; no further constraints stated.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionSpace::getName
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the option space name.
requirements: The returned reference remains valid only as long as the OptionSpace object remains alive; do not store it beyond the object's lifetime (inferred from returning const std::string&).
Object must be properly constructed before calling.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionSpace::clearVendorSpace
functions.description: Marks the option space as non-vendor specific.
requirements: Object must be properly constructed before calling.
No other preconditions stated.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionSpace::isVendorSpace
functions.description: Returns true if the option space is marked as vendor-specific; false otherwise.
requirements: Object must be properly constructed before calling.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionSpace::setVendorSpace
functions.description: Marks the option space as vendor-specific.
requirements: Object must be properly constructed before calling.
No parameters or additional constraints stated.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionSpace::validateName
functions.description: Validates an option space name. Returns true if the name consists only of letters (upper/lowercase), digits, underscores, or dashes, and is non-empty; otherwise returns false.
requirements: name must be non-empty and contain only [A-Za-z0-9_-] to be considered valid.
Function does not state that it throws; callers should use the boolean return to decide validity.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionSpace6::OptionSpace6
functions.description: Constructs a DHCPv6 option space marked as non-vendor-specific. Validates the name using OptionSpace::validateName and throws InvalidOptionSpace on failure.
requirements: name must be non-empty and contain only letters (a–z, A–Z), digits (0–9), underscores (_), or dashes (-); otherwise InvalidOptionSpace is thrown.
Callers should be prepared to catch isc::dhcp::InvalidOptionSpace on invalid names.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionSpace6::getEnterpriseNumber
functions.description: Returns the enterprise number associated with this DHCPv6 option space. Intended for vendor-specific spaces; value for non-vendor spaces is not specified in the header comments.
requirements: Object must be properly constructed before calling.
If the space is not vendor-specific, the returned value may not be meaningful (not specified).

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionSpace6::setVendorSpace
functions.description: Marks the DHCPv6 option space as vendor-specific and sets its IANA enterprise number.
requirements: enterprise_number is a 32-bit unsigned value; no additional range constraints are stated.
Object must be properly constructed before calling.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionSpaceContainer::empty
functions.signature:
template<typename ContainerType, typename ItemType, typename Selector>
bool isc::dhcp::OptionSpaceContainer<ContainerType, ItemType, Selector>::empty() const
functions.description: Returns true if no option-space entries are stored in the container. Intended for quick checks before iteration or modification.

functions.name: isc::dhcp::OptionSpaceContainer::addItem
functions.signature:
template<typename ContainerType, typename ItemType, typename Selector>
void isc::dhcp::OptionSpaceContainer<ContainerType, ItemType, Selector>::addItem(const ItemType& item, const Selector& option_space)
